jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Designation: Scientific Director

Job Location: Bengaluru, India

Department: Medicinal Chemistry – Drug Discovery

About Syngene

Syngene International Ltd. (BSE: 539268, NSE: SYNGENE, ISIN: INE398R01022), is an integrated research, development, and manufacturing services solutions company serving the global pharmaceutical, biotechnology, nutrition, animal health, consumer goods, and specialty chemical sectors. Syngene’s 4500+ scientists offer both skills and the capacity to deliver great science, robust data management and IP security and quality manufacturing, at speed, to improve time-to-market and lower the cost of innovation. With a combination of dedicated research facilities for Amgen, Baxter, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Herbalife, as well as 1.9 Mn sq ft of specialist discovery, development, and manufacturing facilities, Syngene works with biotech companies pursuing leading edge science as well as multinationals including GSK and Merck KGaA.

Job Purpose:

The scientist leads programs aimed at discovering new medicines. The role involves contributing to scientific direction, collaborating across disciplines to advance programs to decision points, and directly managing a team of PhD and associate medicinal chemists to achieve program goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Scientific leadership

* Collaborate with multidisciplinary team to formulate and test scientific hypotheses.
* Integrate data from across disciplines to iteratively design and test analogs in pursuit of target candidate profile. Use predictive, visualization and modeling tools effectively.
* Devise synthetic routes. Stay hands-on in the lab. Follow safety and electronic record keeping protocols.
* Keep current with pertinent scientific and technological advances. Seek opportunities to champion new methods. Take measured risks to develop differentiated synthesis and SAR strategies.
* Track the competitive landscape and adjust objectives and strategies accordingly.
* Assists with patent applications. Enable the program’s external communication plan through presentation or publication.

Program leadership

* Lead discovery programs by setting objectives and deliverables, devising strategies and allocating resources.
* Identify key issues and propose solutions. Make timely, evidence-based decisions, including when information is incomplete, to prioritize, redirect or stop lines of investigation, including compound progression.
* Represent Medicinal Chemistry on multidisciplinary teams. Present proposals and progress updates to stakeholders and governance bodies.

People management

* Directly manage a team of PhD and associate chemists. Own their goal-setting, results, performance management and development plans.
* Coach and mentor team members and colleagues. Delegate meaningful leadership responsibilities to train future leaders. Give timely feedback and address performance issues.
* Provide significant input on hiring, performance reviews, and promotions.

Technical Skills:

* Proficiency in medicinal and organic chemistry.
* Comprehensive knowledge of drug discovery principles, concepts and methods.
* Works independently and is experienced in making decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Persuades stakeholders to adopt a different point of view when appropriate.
* Clear written and verbal scientific communication. Tailors messages to the audience and anticipates objections.
* Builds relationships across disciplines and takes part in team decisions.
* Committed to continuous learning and growth.

Educational Qualification:

PhD in Synthetic Organic Chemistry or in Medicinal Chemistry.

Experience:

* 10+ years pharmaceutical industry, including 2+ years of program leadership
* Member of integrated medicinal chemistry programs.
* Proven record of innovative science in lead identification and multiparameter optimization, supported by peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations and patent inventorship.
* Managing and mentoring scientists.

Behavioral Skills:

* A proactive team player.
* Ensure completion of experiments and generate accurate and reproducible data from experiments.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and work on multiple projects simultaneously with; comfortable working in a dynamic environment with changing requirements.
* Good oral and written communication and presentation skills to work in a multi-disciplinary team.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

It is the policy of Syngene to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable legislation or local law. In addition, Syngene will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Sports scientist
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
FlexAbility Physiotherapy and Sports Rehabilitation is a leading center in India dedicated to expert care and personalized recovery solutions. With branches in key Bengaluru locations such as Koramangala and Jayanagar, the clinic specializes in sports injury management, post-surgical rehabilitation, musculoskeletal pain, and neurological conditions. FlexAbility combines clinical excellence, advanced treatment techniques, and a compassionate approach to help individuals recover faster and move with confidence. The team designs customized treatment plans tailored to each person’s needs and goals, focusing on measurable outcomes. FlexAbility is committed to empowering people to take control of their recovery journey, setting high standards in quality, patient experience, and results-driven therapy for individuals and athletes alike.

**Role Description**
The Sports Scientist will work full time on-site at our Bengaluru clinics, collaborating closely with physiotherapists, physicians, and coaches to support evidence-based rehabilitation and performance programs. This role involves assessing athletes and active individuals using scientific methods and tools, analyzing performance and injury risk, and designing individualized training, conditioning, and recovery protocols. The Sports Scientist will collect and interpret data related to biomechanics, strength, endurance, and movement patterns, and translate findings into practical recommendations for clinicians and clients. Daily responsibilities include monitoring progress, updating reports, contributing to multidisciplinary case discussions, and educating clients on safe training and injury prevention. The role also includes assisting in developing research-informed practices, implementing technology-driven assessments, and supporting workshops or educational initiatives within the clinic.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge in sports science, exercise physiology, and biomechanics, with the ability to apply these concepts to assessment and rehabilitation.
* Candidates should possess skills in performance testing, data collection, and analysis using relevant tools and software for sports and movement evaluation.
* Candidates should possess skills in designing individualized training plans, strength and conditioning programs, and injury prevention strategies for athletes and active clients.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with physiotherapists, coaches, and clients, and to present findings clearly.
* Candidates should possess strong observational skills, attention to detail, and critical thinking abilities to interpret clinical and performance data and refine interventions.
* Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, Biomechanics, Physical Education, or a related field.
* Experience working in sports rehabilitation, athletic training, or performance centers is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with technology such as motion analysis systems, wearable trackers, and performance monitoring tools is an advantage.
* Commitment to ethical practice, continuous learning, and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of current sports science and rehabilitation research.

jobs.description:
**Specialist**
– Medicinal Chemistry

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bengaluru

**Function:**
Medicinal Chemistry

**Role Summary**

The Specialist will independently plan and carry out the synthesis of target compounds for drug discovery projects. The role combines hands-on laboratory work with reaction troubleshooting, compound characterization, and scientific documentation. The Specialist may also guide a small team of scientists while managing their own experimental work.

Key Responsibilities

* **Plan and execute synthesis:**
  Review scientific literature, design experiments, and synthesize target compounds that meet project requirements for purity, quantity, and timelines.
* **Troubleshoot reactions:**
  Identify experimental bottlenecks and adjust synthetic routes or reaction conditions as needed.
* **Interpret analytical data:**
  Confirm the identity of target compounds and key intermediates, including compounds with complex structures.
* **Maintain scientific documentation:**
  Record experiments and results accurately and prepare experimental write-ups and other project documentation in line with applicable intellectual property requirements.
* **Support laboratory operations:**
  Follow laboratory safety and industrial hygiene practices, assist with raw material sourcing, and support general laboratory upkeep.
* **Guide scientific work:**
  As needed, coordinate the work of 2–3 scientists to help the team meet project deliverables.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* **PhD in Organic Chemistry with up to 6 years of experience. Recent PhD graduates are encouraged to apply.**
* Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of organic chemistry, with hands-on experience in organic synthesis.
* Ability to plan experiments independently, troubleshoot reactions, and interpret analytical data.
* Strong scientific documentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and guide a small team.

jobs.title: Principal Scientist - Molecular Biology and Protein Biochemistry
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Position Overview**
A dedicated Molecular Biology and Protein Biochemistry scientist is required to establish and grow Bangalore’s in-house capabilities in cell-based assays and protein analysis. The role will support current Biochemistry R&D projects and help develop workflows for future projects and product opportunities.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong experimental execution and troubleshooting skills with an innovative, business-oriented mindset. In addition to building robust laboratory workflows, the scientist will identify opportunities for new biochemistry projects and catalogue additions, explore market needs, investigate underperforming portfolio areas, and engage with customers and potential collaborators.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Establish and support in-house molecular biology, cell-based assay, and protein analysis capabilities within Bangalore Biochemistry R&D. Execute and troubleshoot workflows involving mammalian cell culture, protein extraction, GST-based assay support, SDS-PAGE, Western blotting, protein quantification, chemiluminescent detection, and application or product validation.
  
  
In partnership with cross-functional and global teams, translate scientific and customer needs into new project proposals, product and catalogue opportunities, and practical application data. Contribute to market and portfolio assessments, including investigation of low-selling products and recommendations for improvement, repositioning, or future development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish, execute, and continuously improve molecular biology and protein biochemistry workflows for Biochemistry R&D projects.
* Perform mammalian cell-based experiments, including cell handling, treatment planning, harvesting, and lysate preparation.
* Extract proteins using appropriate lysis buffers, protease and phosphatase inhibitors, and sample-stabilization conditions.
* Perform BCA or equivalent protein quantification assays and normalize samples for downstream analysis.
* Execute SDS-PAGE, protein transfer to PVDF membranes, Ponceau staining, Western blotting, antibody incubation, washing, and chemiluminescent detection.
* Support GST-based experimental workflows, including protein–probe interaction studies, control planning, and data interpretation.
* Optimize and troubleshoot protein-analysis workflows, addressing weak signal, high background, poor transfer, protein degradation, and inconsistent sample loading.
* Maintain accurate experimental records, raw data, image files, calculations, and technical reports.
* Draft and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation for cell biology and protein-analysis workflows.
* Propose new biochemistry projects and catalogue additions based on scientific developments, customer needs, application opportunities, and market research.
* Conduct or coordinate market and portfolio assessments; investigate low-selling products to understand potential technical, application, positioning, or customer-related factors and recommend appropriate next steps.
* Engage with customers to understand their workflows and challenges, discuss application needs, and support technical data generation and product validation.
* Identify and develop potential collaborations with internal teams, external researchers, customers, or other relevant partners.
* Support product and application validation, proof-of-concept studies, customer-facing technical data generation, and internal capability development.
* Coordinate with global R&D, application, product management, quality, EHS, and manufacturing teams as needed.
* Manage critical reagents, including antibodies, buffers, gels, membranes, protein ladders, cell-culture consumables, and assay reagents.
* Ensure compliance with laboratory safety, biological sample handling, chemical hygiene, and documentation requirements.
* Travel as required to support customer engagement, collaboration, project work, or business needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Cell Biology, or a related discipline.
* Preferably 6-10 years of relevant experience in industry or application-driven R&D.

**Required Technical Skills And Experience**

* Mammalian cell culture and cell-based assays, including treatment planning, harvesting, and lysate preparation.
* Protein extraction, sample stabilization, and BCA, Bradford, or equivalent protein quantification.
* SDS-PAGE, PVDF or nitrocellulose transfer, Ponceau staining, Western blotting, antibody optimization, and chemiluminescent imaging.
* Experimental design using appropriate positive, negative, no-light, no-treatment, and competitor controls.
* Strong knowledge of protein chemistry, molecular biology, and biochemical assay principles.
* Troubleshooting protein degradation, weak signal, non-specific bands, high background, uneven transfer, and loading variation.
* Preferred: probe-based assays or photo-affinity labelling; GST workflows; recombinant protein expression and purification; LC-MS, HPLC, or other orthogonal characterization; product or application development; GLP-like documentation and R&D quality systems.

**Behavioural and functional competencies**

* Innovative mindset with the ability to spot scientific, application, and business opportunities.
* Strong experimental planning and troubleshooting mindset, with the ability to guide and train scientific and technical staff and contribute to project planning.
* Good documentation discipline and awareness of data integrity.
* Ability to work independently in a newly developing capability area.
* Cross-functional communication with chemistry, biology, application, product, and commercial teams.
* Scientific curiosity and the ability to translate protocols into robust, reproducible workflows.
* Customer-oriented approach and openness to engaging with customers and collaborators.
* Ability to assess market feedback and portfolio performance and turn findings into actionable proposals.
* Safety-conscious laboratory working style.
* Ability to train junior scientists or technical staff as the capability expands.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.title: Food Quality Analyst — Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO)
jobs.description:
**About the School of Environment and Sustainability (SES)**

The IIHS Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO) at the Kengeri campus is an important part of the SES and integrates state of the art observation and measurement systems for biodiversity, air, water and soil, food and ecosystem services to serve the needs of sustainable management of the campus and function as a research and educational resource for the larger community.

The Food Safety Testing Lab is a part of the LTUEO and Sustainable Urban Agriculture initiative at the IIHS Kengeri campus, within the SES.

**Job Description**

IIHS seeks a meticulous and technically skilled food quality analyst/ technician to support the Food Safety Testing Lab in understanding and communicating the changing chemical and microbiological variables of food (both cooked and uncooked) on campus and in the neighboring lake, forest, and urban ecosystems.

The role will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative tests to determine the physical and chemical properties of food, recording and compiling the test results, preparing charts and reports, as well as preparing and incubating plates with cultures. It will also involve defining quality assurance targets and procedures and ensuring their maintenance and continued improvement by reviewing targets, protocols, supplies, processes, equipment, and technologies for quality standards.

The candidate will be expected to spend substantial time at the IIHS Kengeri Campus and provide support as needed, on other IIHS projects under the SES.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual

consent and based on performance, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Collecting, processing and analysing food, vegetable, drink and dairy samples at regular intervals as a part of the campus environmental monitoring system;
* Assisting in setting up and maintaining a food quality lab, maintaining and calibrating equipment, and preparing SOPs and related documents;
* Preparing and maintaining hard-copy and computer-based data sets on all chemical and microbiological food quality environmental variables;
* Helping prepare regular updates on the food safety lab’s activities for the IIHS newsletter and other IIHS communication outputs;
* Contributing to knowledge-sharing events, publications and presentations featuring the food safety lab’s activities, observations and findings at appropriate internal and external forums as needed;
* Participating in relevant teaching and training activities; contributing to curriculum design and the development of teaching materials, including case studies, as relevant;
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The food quality analyst will be an External Consultant coordinating with the Lead – Research, SES at IIHS, be part of the larger SES team and will be required to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development team a diverse group of internal teams and external individuals/ organisations, and students.

**Person Specification**

The candidate should have:

* A Master’s degree of Science/ Technology in Food Technology, Food Science and technology, Food Science and Nutrition, Food Safety and Quality Assurance, Food Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry/ Food Microbiology, Microbiology, or Chemistry;
* 3-4 years of experience in chemical, physical, microbiological, and sensory assessment of food, vegetables and drinks.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual consent, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time. This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in the Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer (Pre-Sales) – Food Supply Chain Traceability
jobs.description:
**Bengaluru · Hybrid · 2–5 years**

Help India's food and agri companies, from FMCG majors to seafood and meat exporters, trace every unit from farm and factory to shelf. As our first-line technical expert in sales, you'll turn the real-world complexity of factories and warehouses into traceability solutions that executives buy and operators actually use.

**About Tralexho**

Tralexho is a patented Traceability-as-a-Service (TaaS) platform for the food and agri supply chain, from raw material and processing to warehousing, distribution and the end consumer. Customers use us to cut losses and counterfeits, recall with precision, and comply from day one with GS1, HACCP, USFDA FSMA 204, EUDR and other standards.

We won the
**MoFPI National Award 2025 for Food Safety & Traceability**
, were shortlisted in
**APEDA's Business Challenge 2026 for export-enabling technology**
, and were named to
**Forbes India DGEMS Select 200**
. We co-authored the
**BIS traceability standard for India**
, are part of NVIDIA Inception, and run AI traceability research with ICAR-CIFT and KUFOS.
*Designed in India, designed for the world.*

**The role**

You'll join the revenue team, reporting to the Head of Sales, and own the technical side of every deal: discovery, demo, proof-of-concept and handover to implementation. You'll work with Indian enterprises serving the domestic market and with exporters selling into the US, EU and beyond.

**What you'll do**

* Run technical discovery with plant heads, quality and supply-chain leaders, and IT, and map the customer's current flows of material, data and systems
* Deliver demos tailored to the customer's own products, lines and warehouses
* Design and run PoCs with product and engineering: scope them, set success criteria, deploy and present the results
* Specify and configure sensors and scanners (barcode/QR, RFID, environmental sensors) for PoCs and deployments, and work with hardware partners on the shop floor
* Answer integration, data and security questions (ERP/WMS, APIs, device connectivity) and compliance questions (FSMA 204, EUDR, GS1, HACCP)
* Write solution proposals and RFP/RFI responses, using AI tools to move fast without cutting corners
* Bring field insight back to product so it shapes what we build next

**Your first 90 days**

* **30 days:**
  Know the platform and our standard hardware set well enough to demo it end to end, and shadow live customer engagements
* **60 days:**
  Run discovery and demos on your own
* **90 days:**
  Lead a PoC, including on-site device setup, from scoping to customer sign-off

**Must-haves**

* 2–5 years (career breaks included) in B2B SaaS pre-sales, solutions engineering or technical consulting
* A solid grasp of SaaS architecture, APIs and data integration
* Comfort explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical buyers, and clear writing for proposals and RFPs

**Nice-to-haves**

* Supply chain, manufacturing, FMCG, seafood, meat or agri-export exposure
* GS1 standards, serialization, packaging aggregation or EPCIS
* SAP or other ERP/WMS integration experience
* Hands-on experience with scanners, sensors or other connected devices in a production or field setting
* Hindi, Kannada or another regional language for plant-floor conversations

**How we work**

We work hybrid. Most work is remote, and we meet in person 4–8 days a month (usually 1–2 days a week) at our Bengaluru HQ in Whitefield, or at customer sites. You'll need to live within commuting distance of Whitefield. Site visits are part of the role: typically once a month to customer plants, warehouses and processing centres, mostly day trips around Bengaluru during working hours. Some sites are meat and seafood processing facilities. Occasional outstation trips are planned in advance, travel and stay are arranged and paid by us, and your first visits are with a teammate.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay plus variable pay tied to revenue
* Real ownership in a small, award-winning team working on food safety at national and global scale

**Hiring process**

A 30-minute intro call → a technical conversation → a mock discovery and demo with our team → a conversation with our founders.

**How to apply**

Click the Apply link to go to our short application form. It takes about 10 minutes: your CV, a few practical details, and two brief questions in your own words. We'd rather explore your experience properly in conversation than ask you to write essays, and we appreciate your interest.

From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development

Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.

6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**

**Working with us**

**We’re hiring |**
Experienced
**Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer**

**Knoxx Foods Australia · Bengaluru (Bangalore)**

This role is based in Bengaluru and requires frequent travel to partner factories across India and willingness to travel overseas when required.

Knoxx Foods develops ingredients and meal components for Australian food manufacturers, including shelf-stable rice and pulses, dry blends and coatings. We’re looking for someone who has managed production at third-party food factories and can represent Knoxx on the factory floor. You’ll oversee how our products are made, how our formulations are protected and whether each order leaves the factory on time and in full.

**What you’ll do**

* **Manage production at partner factories.**
  Agree schedules for trials and commercial runs, confirm raw material and line availability, and track output and yields. When a run falls behind, agree a recovery plan with the factory and follow it through.
* **Verify product and process quality.**
  Conduct frequent site audits to assess facilities, testing capabilities and production practices. Observe live runs to verify that operators follow approved standard operating procedures (SOPs). Check batch records, traceability and test results against Knoxx specifications, then verify that corrective actions work.
* **Protect Knoxx’s intellectual property.**
  Before sharing formulations, process instructions or customer specifications, verify that each factory has confidentiality and access controls in place. During audits, check who can access the information, how printed and electronic copies are controlled, and whether obsolete versions have been withdrawn. Escalate suspected breaches and follow corrective actions through to closure.
* **Plan packaging ahead of every run.**
  Work backwards from the dispatch date to determine when approved pouches, labels and cartons must reach the factory. Confirm quantities, stock and supplier lead times, then track orders through receipt so shortages can be resolved before packing begins.
* **Optimise packaging.**
  Trial pouch sizes, carton configurations and pallet layouts with factories, suppliers and Knoxx R&D. Assess product protection, packing-line performance, waste, cost and container utilisation before recommending changes.
* **Ensure timely factory dispatch.**
  Confirm finished quantities, labels, packing lists, QA release status and freight collection against the committed date. Track each order until it leaves the facility and alert our Australian operations team early enough to act on any shipment risk.

**What you’ll bring**

At least 3 or more years hands-on experience managing production at third-party food manufacturers or co-packers is
**essential**
. You should also have practical experience auditing food factories, checking compliance with SOPs, handling confidential technical information, planning packaging and coordinating dispatch. A qualification in food technology, food science, food processing or a related discipline is a
**must**
.

**What you’ll get**

* Attractive Salary
* Company laptop and phone
* Reimbursement of interstate and overseas expenses.

**To apply**
, send me your CV by LinkedIn message with your current location, earliest firm joining date and
**confirmation that you’re available for domestic and overseas travel as described**
.

jobs.title: Industry Technology Specialist - Technical Service: Distilling and Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guiding purpose. It is how we have made an impact, and it is how we will continue to make a difference.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As an Industry Technology Specialist for Distilling & Biofuel, you will join our Technical Service team within Planetary Health Biosolutions.
  
  
Working closely with our Grain Processing team, you will provide technical support to customers in the grain-based ethanol and biofuel industries. You will design and execute plant trials, troubleshoot complex production challenges, and help customers optimize fermentation and ethanol production processes.
  
  
Through your technical expertise, analytical approach, and cross-functional collaboration, you will turn scientific and process insights into practical solutions that support customer success and business development.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide high-quality technical service to grain-based distilleries and ethanol-producing plants across India.
* Design, coordinate, and execute plant trials and experiments related to grain processing, fermentation, and ethanol production.
* Analyze trial and production data, draw clear conclusions, and communicate findings to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Support customers in optimizing grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Recommend suitable yeast strains and support yeast propagation, viability, vitality, and performance management.
* Troubleshoot stuck or sluggish fermentations, contamination, low yeast viability, process deviations, and reduced ethanol yields.
* Optimize process parameters such as temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Conduct root cause analyses using production data, trends, and relevant statistical methods.
* Support the improvement of sterilization and Clean-in-Place processes to help customers prevent and control contamination.
* Build strong working relationships with customers and collaborate with commercial, application, laboratory, and other cross-functional teams.
* Share technical knowledge and train customer teams to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* Between 5 and 10 years of relevant professional experience in a grain-based distillery, ethanol plant, or biofuel production environment.
* Practical knowledge of grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience working with grains such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat.
* Technical knowledge of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Experience selecting and managing yeast strains for ethanol production.
* Knowledge of yeast propagation and the management of yeast viability and vitality.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation issues, including contamination, low yeast viability, sluggish or stuck fermentation, and reduced ethanol yield.
* The ability to analyze production and trial data using Microsoft Excel or another relevant data-analysis tool.
* The ability to plan and lead plant trials and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across India to support ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* A master’s degree in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* A strong understanding of yeast metabolism and its role in converting sugars into ethanol.
* Experience using statistical tools and data trends to investigate production deviations.
* Experience improving sterilization and Clean-in-Place protocols in an industrial production environment.
* A collaborative approach to solving technical challenges and sharing knowledge with customers and colleagues.
* The ability to work proactively, take responsibility, and translate new ideas into practical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative and scientifically driven environment where innovation, curiosity, and technical expertise are valued.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers, technical specialists, laboratory colleagues, and commercial teams while contributing to the advancement of biological solutions for the distilling and biofuel industries.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to apply your expertise to complex industrial challenges, develop new knowledge, and contribute to solutions that improve process performance and the use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Poultry Nutrition Specialist should have technical expertise and science-driven insights to design, evaluate, and optimize poultry feed formulations. In this role, you will support raw material selection, feed program design, and diet modifications to improve bird performance, health, feed efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also provide analytical and advisory services to R&D, production, and commercial teams on key poultry nutritional considerations. You should be able to learn and adopt Cargill’s nutrition system and apply it in your feed formulations for precise nutrition.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Provide technical support and feed formulations to poultry producers and feed mills for precise nutrition, feeding programs (broilers, layers, breeders), and performance optimization.
* Formulate and optimize poultry feed formulation based on raw material quality, nutrient specifications, cost targets, and production goals.
* Monitor and evaluate feed quality, ingredient variability, and nutritional consistency to ensure feed meet required nutrient specifications and bird performance standards.
* Analyse performance data (FCR, body weight gain, egg production, mortality, etc.) and recommend nutritional interventions to address production challenges.
* Maintain and update nutritional databases (ingredients, feed formulations, nutrient matrices) using laboratory data and industry benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Cargill’s Global Nutrition experts and commercial teams to incorporate market trends, ingredient availability, and cost optimization strategies.
* Conduct trials at Cargill’s Technology Application Centre and support field trials to validate feed formulations, additives, and nutritional strategies and create scientific trial reports.
* Independently solve moderately complex nutritional and production issues, escalating more complex concerns to global experts when required.
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and documentation to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* M.V.Sc (Animal Nutrition).
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in poultry nutrition, feed formulation and poultry industry.
* Demonstrated knowledge of poultry nutritional requirements (broilers, layers, breeders) and feed ingredient evaluation.
* Experience with feed formulation software and nutritional modelling.
* Other minimum qualifications may apply.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Animal Nutrition.
* Experience in commercial poultry operations or feed industry.
* Knowledge of alternative ingredients, feed additives, and enzyme technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
jobs.description:
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.
  
  
Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
* Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
* Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
* Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
* Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.
  
  
Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.
  
  
**About The Team**
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.
  
  
This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
**Description**
Do you enjoy designing and implementing solutions to ambiguous and complex problems? Are you looking to expand your scope of impact and influence strategic decision making? Are you in the market for a new, exciting challenge where you are empowered to use your ingenuity to innovate? If so, we are looking for talented people like you to join our Regulatory, Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) solution delivery team.
  
  
The RISC team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies. In this role, you will work closely with legal, business teams, selling partner experience and support teams, operational excellence, product, BI and data science/engineering teams to deliver high-impact end-to-end safety and compliance solutions. Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
* Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
* Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
* Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
* Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
* Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
* Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
* Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.
* Write with Clarity and Purpose: Author crisp, well-structured documents—SOPs, program updates, leadership narratives—that make complex information accessible and drive informed decision-making.
* Be the Operational Backbone: Keep the trains running. Maintain visibility across workstreams, remove blockers, track commitments, and create the organizational structure that makes everyone on the team more effective at their jobs.

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

* 5+ years of program or project Management experience

jobs.description:
**Overview**
Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as a leader in this category. We are seeking talented individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. Candidates will be working with top healthcare providers in the country and leverage RPM's innovation to tackle healthcare's biggest challenges - from resource constraints to quality outcomes, to new care models.
  
  
As our Assistant Manager, Regulatory Affairs, you will be part of Dozee’s Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs team, leading regulatory impact assessments, labeling and claims review, and regulatory intelligence, keeping teams informed on current regulatory trends and changing US and international requirements. You will also support regulatory submissions, working in partnership with Product, Engineering, Quality and Marketing. * Monitor current regulatory trends and changing US and international requirements (for example FDA software, AI/ML, cybersecurity and remote monitoring guidance), assess their impact on Dozee products and processes, and keep teams informed.
* Advise project teams from concept through launch on regulatory pathways, intended use and indications for use, and regulatory requirements.

* Support international registrations and regulatory questions (for example India CDSCO and other markets), working with in-country partners as needed.
* Partner with Quality on regulatory commitments and post-market decisions, including FDA status updates, reportability and field action assessments.

* 5+ years of regulatory affairs experience with US FDA-regulated medical devices.
* Master’s degree in science or a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Life Sciences.

**Job Title:**
Product Engineer, Gaming

**Location:**
Bangalore, India (Full-Time In-Office)

**About:**

We are dedicated to creating unique and exceptional gaming experiences. Our studio is a place where
**data-driven strategy meets deep engineering ownership**
, and where engineers don’t just build features , they shape product outcomes.

We are looking for
**high-IQ, product-minded engineers**
who can think from first principles, move fast, and take end-to-end ownership of systems that directly impact player experience, retention, and monetization.

**The Role:**

You’ll be the person who
**collapses the gap between idea and evidence**
.

From the first whiteboard discussion to the first playtest to the first feature shipped, you own that arc end-to-end. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Art and Engineering to turn
**hypotheses → prototypes → production systems**
.

This is not a pure coding role. It’s not a pure product role.

It’s for someone who is operates credibly in both

**What You'll Do:**

* **Ideation & Concept Testing**
  : Rapidly prototype game ideas in days, define clear hypotheses, instrument for signal, and decide fast—iterate or kill.
* **Prototyping & 0→1 Ownership**
  : Own prototype lifecycle end-to-end (scope → build → playtest → decision) with a focus on speed and learning.
* **Feature Development & System Ownership**
  : Take validated ideas to production, ensuring clean execution, minimal drift, and strong launch readiness.
* **Core Game Systems**
  : Build scalable, config-driven systems (progression, economy, live ops, FTUE) optimized for fast iteration.
* **Experimentation & Data**
  : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
* **Product Thinking**
  : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first-principles thinking.

**What You'll Bring:**

***Must-Haves:***

* Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
* Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and
  **learned from its success/failure**
* High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well-structured way.
* Massive attention to detail, ensuring you don’t miss any minor issues.
* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.

***Nice-to-Haves:***

* Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live-service title.
* Proven track record of taking a prototype → live feature within a professional games studio environment.
* Hands-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
* Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems

**Why You'll Love It Here:**

* **Impact:**
  You will have a direct and measurable impact on our very ambitious game, shaping its visual identity and commercial success.
* **Ownership:**
  You will be given the autonomy and resources to build and lead a high-performance creative product vertical.
* **Innovation:**
  You will be at the forefront of the industry, empowered to explore and implement cutting-edge technologies like AI.
* **Culture:**
  You will join a passionate, collaborative, and data-informed team that values both creative excellence and business results.
* **Benefits:**
  We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and a work environment that strongly supports your professional growth.

jobs.title: Trading Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  

* The Full Stack Developer – Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users.
* Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using .NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities.
* The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer.

Key Accountabilities
  
  
**RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY:**
Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments.
  
  
**FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY:**
Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation.
  
  
**BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs:**
Develops .NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns.
  
  
**OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION:**
Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL.
  
  
**ENGINEERING QUALITY:**
Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY:**
Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions.
  
  
**COLLABORATION:**
Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements.
  
  
**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT:**
Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience delivery of user-facing reporting or analytics solutions, with proven ability to guide and mentor other engineers.
  
  
**Required Skills:**
**Mandatory:**

* Strong experience developing backend services using .NET
* Strong experience building frontend applications using React
* Hands-on experience with AgGrid for large, data-intensive reporting views
* Exposure to cloud-native deployment models and CI/CD pipelines

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working with risk, finance, or trading reporting platforms
* Experience consuming and querying OpenSearch for fast, flexible reporting and fuzzy filtering

jobs.description:
Job Description | Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Research & Development
  
  
**Role at a glance**
Mosaic Wellness is hiring an Assistant Manager to own gummy and nutraceutical development, from bench formulation to commercial launch.
  
  
**Position**
Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals
**Function**
Research & Development (New Product Development)
**Location**
Thane West, Mumbai
**Reports to**
Head of R&D
**Experience**
6–10 years in nutraceutical R&D, including hands-on gummy development
**Education**
M.Sc. (Science) or M.Tech in a relevant discipline
**Travel**
Regular visits to CDMO and supplier sites across India
**Employment**
Full-time
  
  
**About Mosaic Wellness**
Mosaic Wellness is a Mumbai-based, digital-first health and wellness company. Its consumer brands, including Man Matters, Be Bodywise and Little Joys, serve men’s, women’s and children’s health and nutrition needs.
  
  
Our R&D team develops science-led nutraceuticals, functional foods and personal care products with manufacturing partners across India. Gummies are a key format across the portfolio.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You will own gummy and nutraceutical products end to end: formulation on the bench, scale-up at CDMOs, and a stable, compliant commercial launch.
  
  
The role solves the hard problems of the gummy format: high active loads, taste masking, sugar reduction, texture and shelf-life stability. You will be R&D’s point person for this category across brands, working closely with Brand, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement and manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Formulation and product development**

* Develop gummies across gelling systems (gelatin, pectin, carrageenan, agar, starch), including vegan, sugar-free and reduced-sugar variants.
* Formulate with demanding actives: vitamins, minerals, botanicals, probiotics, prebiotic fibres and other high-load ingredients.
* Engineer taste and texture through bitterness masking, flavour and acid profiling, chew optimisation, colour stability, sanding and oil coating.
* Design out gummy failure modes: sweating, stickiness, crystallisation, syneresis, heat deformation, browning and active degradation.
* Extend expertise to other formats as needed: powders and sachets, tablets, capsules, effervescents and chewables.

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  

* Run bench trials, Design of Experiments (DoE) and sensory evaluations, with complete lab records.

**Process development, scale-up and tech transfer**

* Define critical process parameters: cook temperature and solids (°Brix), deposit pH and temperature, deposit weight, curing conditions and final water activity.
* Lead pilot, scale-up and first commercial batches on starch mogul and starchless depositing lines at CDMO sites.
* Prepare tech-transfer packages: formula, bill of materials, process flow, Master Formula Record inputs and specifications.
* Troubleshoot weight variation, tailing, mould sticking and yield loss to deliver right-first-time commercialisation.

**Stability, quality and analytics**

* Design accelerated and real-time stability studies under ICH-aligned conditions (including Zone IVb, 30 °C/75% RH) to set overages and shelf life.
* Write raw material, packaging and finished-goods specifications; review analytical data with in-house teams and NABL-accredited labs.
* Select packaging for moisture and oxygen protection, backed by water-activity and moisture-sorption data.
* Lead root-cause analysis and CAPA for deviations, out-of-specification results and consumer complaints.

**Regulatory and documentation**

* Keep formulations and labels compliant with FSSAI’s Health Supplements and Nutraceuticals Regulations (2022), Labelling and Display Regulations (2020) and AYUSH norms where relevant.
* Check ingredient permissibility, RDA-based limits and label claims; prepare technical dossiers, including for Non-Specified Food approvals.
* Support export-market requirements (e.g., GCC, US 21 CFR) with Regulatory Affairs.

**Ingredients, partners and cost**

* Scout and qualify new ingredients, technologies and suppliers, and develop alternate sources for supply resilience.
* Assess CDMO capability and build strong technical partnerships with manufacturing and ingredient partners.
* Hit COGS targets through formulation and process value engineering, without compromising efficacy or sensory quality.

**Collaboration and team**

* Translate brand and consumer briefs into technical briefs, and deliver launches on the NPD calendar with cross-functional teams.
* Guide and mentor junior scientists, and share learnings across R&D.
* Track global gummy and delivery-format trends, and contribute to patents and scientific publications.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Education**
**One Of The Following**

* M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology, Food and Nutrition, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Pharmaceutical Technology

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  
**Experience**

* 6–10 years in R&D or NPD for nutraceuticals, health supplements or functional foods, at a consumer brand, nutraceutical company or CDMO.
* At least 3 years of hands-on gummy development, with products taken from concept to commercial launch.
* Scale-up experience on mogul or starchless depositing lines, in-house or at a CDMO.
* A track record of stability-led formulation, setting overages and shelf life for vitamins, botanicals or probiotics.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong grasp of hydrocolloid and sugar/polyol science: gelation, pH and calcium sensitivity, glass transition, crystallisation and water activity.
* Confident with analytical data: assay and HPLC results, moisture and water activity, texture analysis and microbiology.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI nutraceutical and labelling regulations, GMP and HACCP.
* Structured experimentation (DoE), clear technical documentation and crisp reporting.
* Able to run several projects, CDMOs and stakeholders in parallel.

**Good to have**

* Experience with tablets, capsules, softgels, powders or effervescents alongside gummies.
* Probiotic, high-fibre, high-load or centre-filled gummy development.
* Work with microencapsulated actives or other novel delivery formats.
* Exposure to export regulations: US 21 CFR 111, GCC (GSO) or EU.
* Experience in a D2C or fast-growing consumer health company.
* Patents or peer-reviewed publications.
* Statistical tools such as Minitab, JMP or Design-Expert.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**
Within a year, gummies are a dependable, scalable platform for Mosaic’s brands.
  
  

* Gummy and nutraceutical launches delivered on the NPD calendar, scaled up right first time at CDMOs.
* Every launched SKU meets label claim through shelf life, backed by robust stability data.
* Measurable COGS savings from value engineering on existing products.
* A stronger gummy platform: documented process windows, qualified alternate suppliers and fewer quality complaints.

**Why join**
You get real ownership, scientific depth and room to grow.
  
  

* Own a key format end to end, with direct influence on what reaches consumers.
* Work in a lean, decentralised R&D team where scientists own their projects and decisions sit close to the bench.
* Grow beyond gummies into nutraceuticals, functional foods and novel delivery technologies.
* Build your scientific profile through patents and publications, alongside leaders with deep global CPG experience.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager (Field Technical Support – CNG)
jobs.description:
**Company:** CEV Engineering  
**Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.
* Evaluate dealer technicians' technical knowledge and capabilities.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly field issue reports.
* Maintain a technical complaint database and track issue closure.
* Prepare 8D reports, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective Action Reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.
* Present technical performance and improvement plans to management.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM Quality, Service, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support new vehicle launches and CNG system validation activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for spare parts availability and technical support.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of CNG vehicle systems and components.
* Knowledge of CNG regulators, injectors, pressure sensors, cylinders, HP tubes, and fittings.
* Understanding of CNG diagnostics and scanning tools.
* Knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Understanding of warranty processes and quality tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D).
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and technical reporting.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.
* Number of dealer technical training sessions conducted.
* Improvement in first-time-right repair performance.
* Reduction in unnecessary part replacement.
* Timely submission of RCA and corrective action reports.

**5. Competencies Required**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Team management and leadership abilities.
* Effective communication and coordination.
* Decision-making and escalation management.
* Customer and dealer handling skills.
* Willingness to travel for field inspections and dealer support.

**6. Expected Deliverables**

* Timely resolution of CNG field issues.
* Improved dealer technical capabilities.
* Reduced warranty cost and repeat complaints.
* Effective coordination with OEM and plant teams.
* Improved CNG service quality and customer satisfaction.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

**Purpose of the Role**

* Support the development and data generation for registration of crop-protection products through high-quality analytical testing and product chemistry studies.
* The role requires hands-on laboratory work, strong data integrity and strict adherence to OECD GLP, HSE and quality standards

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform analytical and product chemistry testing of technical materials, raw materials, intermediates, by-products and formulations.
* Use and maintain analytical instruments including GC, HPLC and spectroscopic equipment.
* Conduct formulation and physical-property studies, including pH, density, viscosity, surface tension and suspensibility.
* Plan laboratory work, monitor and interpret storage-stability studies.
* Produce accurate, traceable raw data, calculations and reports in line with SOPs and GLP requirements.
* Support the Study Director or Line manager for product-development, registration, manufacturing and supply-chain projects; communicate findings clearly to study leadership.
* Follow safe laboratory practices, good housekeeping and proactive risk management.

**Skills and Behaviours**

* Knowledge of OECD GLP, data integrity, laboratory safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Proactive, independent, and solution-focused approach.
* Experienced study personnel in GLP test facility.
* Strong presentation, interpersonal, and technical-writing skills

  
**Qualifications**

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

* PhD or master’s degree in chemistry or a related discipline; Analytical Chemistry preferred.
* At least 1 year’s relevant experience with a PhD, or 3 years with a master’s degree.
* Experience in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals Industries or a GLP-certified CRO.
* Practical experience with GC, HPLC, spectroscopy and computerised data systems.
* Working knowledge of OECD GLP, laboratory safety and chemical-hazard management.
* Detail-oriented, organised and able to deliver reliable results within agreed timelines.
* Collaborative, adaptable and keen to build technical expertise in a cross-functional R&D environment.

* Competitive insurance scheme
* Employee assistance program – to take care of your and your loved ones mental health
* Paid Vacation of 30days, 12 Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, compassionate leaves
* Education assistance – for your career growth
* People first culture translated into ‘*Most Preferred place to work 2022-23 by Times group’*

jobs.title: R&D Domain Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Manager

### 

**What We Believe In**
----------------------

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, quality control solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

In this role, we are looking for an R&D Engineer – System 800xA & Quality Control System (QCS) to join our Process Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the validation, testing, and lifecycle support of ABB System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions, ensuring high-quality, reliable, and secure industrial automation software for the Pulp & Paper industry.

Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies, perform end-to-end system integration testing, and collaborate with Product Management, Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to deliver robust automation solutions while driving continuous quality improvements.

This role is contributing to the Process Industries – System 800xA & QCS Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for**
--------------------------------------

* Develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies for System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, system, cybersecurity, and end-to-end testing to ensure product quality, reliability, and compliance with ABB engineering standards.
* Validate industrial automation solutions by testing DCS integrations, QCS control strategies, process parameters, alarm management, historical data, industrial communication, and overall system performance across diverse operating scenarios.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Software Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to manage defect lifecycles, support release readiness, participate in Agile ceremonies, and deliver high-quality software using modern testing methodologies, Azure DevOps, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
* Drive engineering excellence by developing test automation frameworks, improving validation processes, mentoring team members, maintaining technical documentation, supporting customer demonstrations, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications for the Role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in software testing or validation for Industrial Automation, DCS, PLC, SCADA, or Quality Control Systems, with hands-on experience in ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, and Control Builder M.
* Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional, system, integration, regression, simulation, and end-to-end validation, along with experience using Azure DevOps, Git/TFS, and test automation frameworks.
* Experience with Quality Control Systems (QCS), DCS integration, industrial process control, and Pulp & Paper applications is preferred, with knowledge of IEC 61131-3 programming and industrial automation architectures.
* Understanding of Industrial Cybersecurity (IEC 62443), automated testing practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and Agile software development methodologies is considered an advantage.
* Professional certifications such as ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent testing certifications are preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional global teams and drive continuous quality improvement initiatives.

**More About Us**

ABB's Process Industries business serves customers across mining, minerals, metals, cement, pulp & paper, battery manufacturing, food & beverage, and other industrial sectors by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.

Our R&D organization develops next-generation industrial automation software, distributed control systems, Quality Control Systems (QCS), cloud-enabled digital platforms, and intelligent engineering solutions that help customers optimize manufacturing processes and accelerate digital transformation. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced automation technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial operations.

At ABB, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams to build world-class automation and quality control solutions while advancing your expertise in industrial software, system validation, digital engineering, and AI-assisted testing. We foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion where every individual is empowered to make a meaningful impact.

ABB is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment is subject to applicable background verification and pre-employment screening in accordance with ABB policies.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
