jobs.description:
Food Safety & Production Supervisor

**Company:** Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt Ltd **Location:** Velachery Central Kitchen, Chennai **Reports to:** Head of Operations **Type:** Full-time, on-site (factory-based, with periodic store visits) **Apply to:** jobs@amadora.in

About Amadora

Amadora makes premium artisanal ice cream, baked goods, sauces, bars and cakes from scratch — no premixes, no compounds. Everything is produced at our central kitchen in Chennai on Pastomaster and Carpigiani equipment and distributed to franchise and company-owned stores across Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. As we scale, the discipline of the factory floor is what protects the brand.

The Role

We are looking for a food technologist who has worked as a Food Safety Executive and is ready to own both sides of the floor: making sure production runs the way the process says it should, and making sure food safety norms are followed without exception, every single day.

This is a hands-on shop-floor role, not a desk role. You will be present during production, checking that steps are followed as written, catching deviations while they are still small, and holding the line on hygiene, traceability and equipment condition. Alongside the daily work, you will drive our ISO certification programme and partner with the Training team to take food safety standards out to the stores.

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily production supervision

* Verify that every batch is produced to the approved recipe, sequence, temperature and time parameters — pasteurisation, ageing, batch freezing, blast freezing, hardening and packing.
* Run and sign off start-of-shift, in-process and end-of-shift checks; ensure line clearance between batches and between allergen and non-allergen runs.
* Check equipment and tooling condition before use — moulds, scoops, containers, gaskets, blades — and enforce immediate quarantine and physical removal of any damaged, chipped or worn item from the production area.
* Monitor CCPs and record readings in real time; escalate deviations immediately rather than at end of day.
* Verify raw material and packaging at receipt (COA, temperature, condition, shelf life) and enforce FEFO in cold rooms and dry stores.
* Support the production plan — yields, batch sizing, changeover time, wastage — and flag where process adherence and output targets are in conflict.

2. Food safety and hygiene compliance

* Own day-to-day implementation of HACCP, GMP and GHP across the facility.
* Manage personal hygiene, health checks, gowning and handwashing compliance for all production staff.
* Schedule and verify cleaning and sanitation (CIP and manual), pest control, water testing, swab testing and calibration; maintain the records.
* Run the foreign-material control programme: metal, glass, hard plastic, wood and mould-fragment controls, with defined inspection and breakage procedures.
* Manage the finished-goods and shelf-life testing programme, micro sampling and third-party lab coordination.
* Maintain FSSAI licence conditions and Schedule 4 compliance; be the point person for FSSAI and customer audits.
* Investigate customer complaints and internal non-conformances to root cause, define CAPA, and verify that the corrective action actually holds a month later.
* Maintain full batch traceability and be able to run a mock recall to closure.

3. ISO / FSSC certification

* Lead preparation for ISO 22000:2018 (and FSSC 22000 where applicable) — gap assessment, documentation, PRPs, HACCP plan, internal audits, management review and closure of certification body findings.
* Build and maintain the food safety management system documentation: manual, procedures, formats, records.
* Train and hand-hold the production team through the changes the certification requires, so the system survives after the certificate is issued.

4. Store food safety, with the Training team

* Work with the Head of Training to convert factory food safety standards into simple, teachable store-level procedures — cold chain, thawing, display, scooping hygiene, cleaning schedules, expiry management, allergen handling.
* Co-create training content, checklists and audit formats for franchise and company-owned stores.
* Conduct periodic store food safety audits, score them, and drive closure of findings with the operations and training teams.
* Support franchisee-side FSSAI compliance and readiness for regulatory inspections.

5. Documentation and reporting

* Maintain daily, weekly and monthly food safety and production compliance dashboards.
* Report non-conformances, wastage, complaint trends and audit scores to management with clear cause and action.

Qualifications and Competencies

**Required**

* B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Sc / M.Sc in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience, including a proven stint as a Food Safety Executive or Officer in a food manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of HACCP, GMP, GHP, FSSAI regulations and Schedule 4.
* Experience preparing for or maintaining ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 certification.
* Comfortable with documentation and record discipline — you can build a format, and you can also make people fill it correctly.
* Physically comfortable working in a cold-chain environment, including chillers and blast freezers, and around early production shifts.

**Preferred**

* Dairy, frozen dessert, bakery or chocolate manufacturing background.
* Certified HACCP Level 3 / ISO 22000 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor.
* Multi-site or retail-outlet audit exposure.
* Working Tamil and English; Kannada or Telugu a bonus given our other markets.

**Competencies we care about**

* Willingness to stop a batch. The right answer is sometimes expensive, and we want someone who says it anyway.
* Firm without being adversarial — you will be enforcing standards on colleagues you work beside every day.
* Bias for root cause over blame; interest in why the process allowed the mistake, not just who made it.
* Attention to detail that holds up on day 200, not just day 20.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

* **Month 1–3:** You have mapped every production line end to end, documented the actual process against the written SOP, and produced a prioritised gap list covering process adherence, hygiene, equipment condition and record-keeping.
* **Month 3–4:** Daily production and food safety checks are running consistently across all shifts, with real-time recording and same-day escalation of deviations — verified by you, not self-reported.
* **Month 6:** The ISO 22000 documentation set is complete, PRPs and the HACCP plan are implemented, and the first full internal audit cycle has been completed with CAPAs closed.
* **Month 6–9:** A store food safety standard, training module and audit checklist are live with the Training team, and the first round of audits is complete across Chennai stores.
* **Month 9–12:** ISO certification audit cleared, with no major non-conformances outstanding.
* **Through the year:** A measurable fall in food-safety-related customer complaints and internal non-conformances, with a traceability and mock-recall capability that closes within the target window.

Why Amadora

You will be the person who owns food safety at a brand that makes everything from scratch — which means real process, real risk and real ownership, not a premix line where the standards were set by someone else. You will build the system, certify it, and take it out to every store. Direct access to the founder and the leadership team, and a company growing fast enough that what you build now becomes how it operates at three times the size.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

CTB Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. is a growing B2B bakery manufacturer supplying burger buns, breads, pitas, pizza bases and specialty bakery products to restaurants, cafés, QSRs and cloud kitchens.

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, hands-on QA professional to **take ownership of our quality assurance and food safety function**.

This is a leadership role requiring someone who can independently assess existing practices, establish effective quality systems, implement improvements and ensure consistent standards throughout our manufacturing operations.

**We are looking for a person who takes initiative, solves problems and drives results—not someone who simply conducts inspections or maintains records.**

* **Ensure product quality and process compliance** throughout manufacturing, from incoming materials and ingredient preparation to production, packaging and finished goods.

* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology or a related discipline.

* Strong practical knowledge of FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, quality documentation and audits.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or improving QA systems, SOPs, process controls and CAPA.
* Ability to independently manage QA activities, guide staff and coordinate effectively with production teams.
* Strong organizational, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Hands-on approach, high personal accountability and the ability to follow through without constant supervision.

**Preference will be given to candidates who have personally established, implemented or substantially improved quality systems in a food manufacturing facility.**

What We Offer

**NULO IS:**

We are the fastest-growing U.S. pet food specialty brand and have recently begun our European expansion with major retail listings across Italy, Spain and the UK. We were named “Top 25 Most Innovative Consumer Brands” by Forbes Magazine, offering industry-leading dog and cat food products with a world-class sales team, in a multi-billion-dollar industry that’s ripe for innovation and change. Imagine inspiring pet parents to think differently about the experience of feeding their dogs and cats, to feed them like the little athletes they are - with foods high in meat protein, low in carbs and infused with viable probiotics. To learn more visit www.nulo.co.uk

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels
* **Build & Optimise the Nulo Demand Generation Engine –** working with the wider marketing team, develop and own a full-funnel demand generation programme that drives brand awareness, consideration and trial to recruit consumers at scale
* **Develop Consumer & Category Insight** - build a deep understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitors and emerging trends, converting insight into clear actions for the brand and portfolio.
* **Drive Brand Health & Performance** - track brand, category and commercial performance across priority markets, identifying growth opportunities and actions to improve awareness, consideration and trial, driving brand penetration and equity.
* **Shape Local Brand Positioning** - act as a guardian of Nulo’s positioning, distinctive assets and brand codes, ensuring global consistency is combined with local relevance
* **Portfolio Strategy & Innovation** - Lead on product lifecycle including performance analysis, opportunity identification, working with global teams on innovation and renovation
* **Lead Integrated Brand Campaign Development** - work with local & global teams and agency partners to develop and execute local campaigns.
* **360 Customer Planning** – lead development and execution of joint customer marketing plans.
* **Support Pricing & Portfolio Architecture** - partner with Commercial and Finance to inform pricing, pack architecture, promotional strategy and portfolio choices that support brand equity and profitable growth.
* **Brand P&L management** - manage and report on full brand P&L including managing brand investment, setting priorities and evaluating activity effectiveness
* **Agency & Partner Management** - lead relevant agency and specialist partner relationships, setting clear briefs and ensuring high-quality, on-brand delivery against timings and budgets.
* **Cross-functional Brand Leadership** - act as a key connector across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Global Teams to align priorities and deliver key initiatives

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, food, pet, or a related consumer-goods sector.
* Strong experience developing annual brand plans and translating consumer and commercial insight into clear growth strategies.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using consumer, category and commercial data to identify opportunities and measure performance.
* Commercial mindset with an understanding of pricing, promotional strategy, portfolio architecture and brand P&L drivers.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns and working across the full funnel
* Demonstrable experience working with key customers including joint business planning and shopper activations.
* Strong agency and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for others.
* Budget management experience and a strong focus on investment effectiveness.
* Fluent English and Spanish.

**Desirable Experience & Skills**

* Experience working across multiple European markets.
* Experience managing a portfolio, including innovation / NPD, renovation, proposition development and product launches.
* Experience within pet food, pet care, food, beverage or another premium FMCG category.
* Additional European languages are a plus.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* **Brand Builder** - you care deeply about what makes brands distinctive and know how to build equity consistently over time.
* **Consumer Obsessed** - you are curious about people, culture and behaviour and use insight to inform brand strategy.
* **Commercially minded** – you are comfortable converting business objectives into marketing objectives and strategies
* **Analytical** - you are comfortable with data and use it to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* **Hands-on** - you are equally comfortable shaping strategy, reviewing packaging, building a business case, briefing an agency and preparing a customer story.
* **Entrepreneurial** - you are a self-starter who thrives in a growing organisation where not every process or answer already exists.
* **Collaborative** - you build strong relationships across functions, markets and external partners
* **Fast & Pragmatic** - you maintain high standards without sacrificing pace of execution in the pursuit of perfection.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET:**

* Competitive salary and benefits, in line with the local market and experience.
* Full-time, permanent contract.
* Travel costs covered in line with company policy.

**Location**

This is a full-time, mostly remote position, with frequent European travel. We need this person to be willing to travel frequently around Europe.

jobs.title: Data Science Manager - Applied AI
jobs.description:
Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
  
  
We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
  
  
Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.
  
  
****Job Description****
**About the Applied AI Tribe**
The Applied AI Tribe is talabat's internal AI engine, a team obsessed with turning cutting-edge AI into genuine, measurable business value. We don't build AI for its own sake. Our north star is Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**We have shipped 40+ AI products across four strategic streams:**

* Product & Tech Platform - AI capabilities embedded into talabat's core product and engineering platform.
* Business Automations - streamlined workflows that save real time and money across operations.
* Self-Serve AI Tools - empowering talabatis to build and use AI without needing to raise a ticket.
* Training & Onboarding - upskilling the tribe so every team can participate in the AI era.

Our engineering approach is built around shipping agentic AI systems at scale, with a harness-first philosophy, evaluation embedded into every product iteration, and production feedback loops that drive the roadmap.
  
  
**The Role**
As Manager, Data Scientist - AI within the Applied AI Tribe, you will lead a team of data scientists building and shipping the ML and generative AI systems that power decisions across talabat's product and business. You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****
**What Did We Order?**
****Technical Experience****

* Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, and data mining.
* Hands-on knowledge of ML and GenAI frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and LLM fine-tuning.
* Proficiency with the OpenAI SDK and familiarity with major LLM provider APIs for building and orchestrating production AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph for building stateful, multi-step agentic workflows and complex agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with Hugging Face (Transformers, Hub, Inference API) for model sourcing, fine-tuning, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of embeddings, dense and sparse retrieval, vector databases, and semantic search, for building RAG pipelines and similarity-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean production code, data structures and algorithms, ML system design.
* Proven experience shipping and monitoring ML models in production, with a solid grasp of MLOps practices.
* Strong data and ML engineering skills: building and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow) and robust feature engineering.
* Excellent SQL and Python; solid statistical foundations including experiment design, causal inference, and predictive methods.
* Familiarity with agentic system design (harness-first thinking, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and production feedback loops) is a strong plus.
* Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A postgraduate degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, and/or generative AI, including shipping models to production.
* 2+ years managing or leading a data science or ML team, with a track record of developing talent and delivering through others.
* Experience building ML systems in an online consumer product environment is a strong plus.

****Additional Information****
Mindset & Ways of Working
  
  

* Curiosity over certainty: you're excited to try the new model or framework this week.
* Ownership: you treat cost, latency, and business impact as your problem, and your team's.
* Bias to build: a prototype in a real workflow beats a perfect design doc every time.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: most of what we build has no playbook yet, and you help write it.
* Keep it simple: pick the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity, and #makeithappen.

**At talabat, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters, and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.**

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Head Chef will be responsible for overseeing all kitchen operations, ensuring consistent food quality, maintaining high standards of food presentation, managing kitchen staff, controlling food costs, and ensuring compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations.

The role requires strong culinary expertise, leadership capabilities, creativity, and the ability to manage kitchen operations efficiently while ensuring customer satisfaction and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Kitchen Operations & Food Production:**

* Oversee and manage all daily kitchen operations.
* Ensure timely preparation and delivery of food orders.
* Maintain consistency in food quality, taste, portion sizes, and presentation.
* Develop and implement standard recipes and food preparation procedures.
* Ensure all dishes are prepared according to company standards.
* Monitor kitchen workflow and ensure efficient coordination between kitchen sections.
* Introduce new dishes, seasonal menus, and innovative food concepts.
* Ensure proper utilization of kitchen equipment and facilities.

**Menu Planning & Development:**

* Develop, review, and update food menus in coordination with management.
* Create new recipes and improve existing dishes.
* Conduct food trials and tastings before introducing new menu items.
* Ensure menu pricing is aligned with food costs and profitability targets.
* Monitor food trends and introduce innovative culinary ideas.
* Ensure menu items meet customer expectations and brand standards.

**Team Management & Leadership:**

* Recruit, train, supervise, and develop kitchen employees.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities among kitchen staff.
* Prepare kitchen duty rosters and manage staff scheduling.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Conduct regular training on cooking techniques, food safety, and hygiene.
* Maintain teamwork, discipline, and a positive working environment.
* Identify training needs and support employee development.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels across all kitchen sections.

**Food Cost & Inventory Management:**

* Monitor food costs and ensure achievement of budgeted targets.
* Control food wastage, spoilage, and unnecessary expenses.
* Monitor stock levels and coordinate purchasing requirements.
* Ensure proper receiving, storage, and rotation of food items.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and stocktaking.
* Establish appropriate portion control and standard recipes.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure quality and competitive pricing.
* Monitor kitchen expenses and recommend cost-saving measures.

**Food Safety & Hygiene:**

* Ensure strict compliance with UAE food safety regulations and applicable municipal requirements.
* Maintain high standards of kitchen cleanliness and sanitation.
* Ensure proper food handling, preparation, storage, and temperature control.
* Monitor expiry dates and implement FIFO (First In, First Out) procedures.
* Conduct regular kitchen hygiene and safety inspections.
* Ensure staff follow personal hygiene and grooming standards.
* Maintain food safety records and inspection documentation.
* Take immediate corrective action in case of hygiene or food safety violations.

**Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction:**

* Conduct regular food quality checks before dishes are served.
* Ensure consistency in taste, texture, temperature, and presentation.
* Handle food-related customer complaints professionally.
* Coordinate with restaurant service teams to ensure smooth food delivery.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement necessary improvements.
* Ensure all special dietary requirements and food allergies are handled appropriately.

**Equipment & Maintenance:**

* Ensure kitchen equipment is maintained in good working condition.
* Report equipment breakdowns and coordinate timely repairs.
* Ensure proper use and handling of kitchen tools and machinery.
* Monitor kitchen safety procedures and prevent workplace accidents.
* Maintain organized storage areas and kitchen workstations.

**Administration & Reporting:**

* Prepare daily and monthly kitchen operational reports.
* Monitor food cost percentages, wastage, and inventory consumption.
* Maintain recipe cards, food costing sheets, and kitchen records.
* Report operational challenges and staffing requirements to management.
* Assist management with budgeting and operational planning.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and standard operating procedures.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in professional kitchen operations.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a Head Chef or Sous Chef role.
* Strong experience in menu development, food costing, and kitchen management.
* Knowledge of international cuisines and modern cooking techniques.
* Good understanding of UAE food safety regulations.
* Experience in managing and developing multicultural kitchen teams.
* Previous UAE experience is a must.

* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.

* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.

* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.

* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.

**Interested in a career that matters?**

**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.

* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.

* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.

**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

jobs.description:
**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.
  
  
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**
**Role Summary**
**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**
The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.
  
  
This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.
  
  
The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.
  
  
**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**
This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.
  
  
Role duties and accountabilities
  
  

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

**Experience, Skills, Knowledge**
Experience Required
  
  

* 5-10 years of experience in relevant scientific field
* Proven expertise engaging with and mobilising scientific KOLs / PHAs and interest groups
* Knowledge and experience of BAT's New Category products, ingredients, and technologies
* Familiarity with BAT’s 9-step scientific risk assessment framework and Tobacco Harm Reduction principles
* Sound knowledge of tobacco, food, or pharmaceutical science complexities including chemistry, toxicology, pre-clinical, clinical, and behavioural science
* Understanding of the regulatory environment in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, especially concerning tobacco, food, medicinal, and pharmaceutical sectors
* Proven experience interacting with regulatory authorities in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, managing pharmaceutical regulations, regulatory pathways, and scientific requirements, with the capacity to apply this knowledge to complex scientific and policy discussions
* Experience in managing complex market-facing and regulatory dependent projects
* Understands World Health Organization’s political environment and public policy-making processes
* Experience of crafting and managing 3rd party networks
* Experience in regulatory rulemaking processes
* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner

Beneficial

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island:**
Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, water features, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.
  
  
**About The Position**
Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking F&B Licensing Manager to join the resort’s Food & Beverage team.
  
  
**The Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Are**

* Build and maintain the end ‑ to ‑ end licensing roadmap for Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars/lounges, in ‑ venue service points, storage areas, kitchens, outdoor spaces), mapping initial approvals, renewals, amendments, and closures.
* Own a central license register (master tracker) covering legal entity documents, trade/operational licenses, alcohol/beverage permissions where applicable, health & hygiene certificates, music/entertainment permits, signage, outdoor seating, terrace use, delivery, and vehicle/transport approvals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant Emirate ‑ level and federal authorities (e.g., Economic Development, Municipality/Public Health, Tourism Authority, Civil Defense, Police/Events, and other regulators as applicable) to obtain, amend, and renew approvals.
* Interpret new regulations, assess impact, and update SOPs; cascade requirements across venues and support implementation.
* Lead all event ‑ related licensing and notifications (e.g., celebrations, tastings, brand activations, outdoor events, one ‑ off extensions of hours/areas), coordinating site plans, crowd management, entertainment permits, and security/Civil Defense clearances.
* Partner with Restaurant Events and venue leaders to build permit ‑ ready event packs (layouts, capacities, NOCs, risk assessments) and to secure approvals on time
* Oversee authorized PROs, translation/legalization services, and specialized consultants; negotiate scopes, SLAs, and fees.
* Maintain a calendar of statutory payments (govt. fees, renewals, inspections) and forecast the licensing budget; reconcile costs against plan.
* Maintain accurate license files (digital and physical), logs of submissions and approvals, and a library of approved layouts/certificates.
* Publish weekly dashboards (licenses due in 90/60/30 days, event permits in progress, inspection outcomes, fines/penalties avoided).
* Run the daily licensing control room: check expiries, validate opening checklists for permit ‑ dependent activities, and green ‑ light venue operations.
* Review event requests; confirm permitting path, lead times, and documentation; submit and track approvals through to issuance.
* Verify display of licenses (where mandated), on ‑ site documentation (HACCP, allergen matrices, employee certifications), and emergency contacts.
* Work with the respective outlet management team and designate Venue Licensing Champions in each outlet.
* Conduct induction and refresher training on licensing rules (alcohol service where applicable, events, outdoor use, deliveries, signage), documentation, and inspection etiquette.
* Monitor UAE market and regulatory trends; recommend operational adjustments and process improvements.
* Collaborate positively with all departments and contractors; lead cross ‑ functional licensing meetings and share relevant updates.

**About You:**
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 4–6 years in licensing/compliance for hospitality/Food & Beverage, large venues, or integrated resorts in the UAE; proven track record managing multi ‑ venue portfolios and events permits.
* Working knowledge of UAE/Emirate ‑ level licensing frameworks, municipal public health, tourism/entertainment permits, Civil Defense requirements, and HACCP/food safety.
* Advantageous: experience with alcohol licensing and responsible service standards where applicable; Arabic reading or business proficiency.
* Familiarity with e ‑ government portals and document legalization/attestation processes.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, document management systems, and tracker dashboards (e.g., Excel/SharePoint/Power BI).

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

We are currently hiring a **MIS & Reporting Analyst** to join our Aftersales Automotive team. This is an exciting opportunity for a data-driven professional who can transform complex information into accurate, meaningful, and actionable business insights.

You will play a key role in management reporting, business intelligence, data analysis, dashboard development, and reporting automation, helping stakeholders make informed business decisions.

**What you will do**

* Prepare accurate and timely daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports covering operational, customer, and financial KPIs.
* Extract, consolidate, cleanse, validate, and reconcile data from SAP, DMS, and other business systems.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and management reports using Power BI and Microsoft Excel.
* Perform trend, variance, productivity, utilization, forecasting, and performance analysis.
* Develop analytical models to support incentive calculations and other business requirements.
* Support data validation, UAT, and resolution of reporting and system-related issues.
* Automate and standardize recurring reporting processes using Power Query, Power BI, Alteryx, or similar tools.
* Work closely with Service Operations, Parts, Finance, IT, CRM, and other stakeholders.

**Skills**

**Required skills to be successful**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with experience working with complex and large datasets.
* Practical experience in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
* Strong data extraction, cleansing, reconciliation, and analytical capabilities.
* Experience working with SAP, DMS, ERP, or similar reporting systems.
* Knowledge of Power Query, Alteryx, or similar data-preparation and automation tools.
* Strong understanding of KPI reporting, forecasting, variance analysis, and trend analysis.
* Excellent attention to detail with a strong focus on data accuracy and integrity.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

**About the team**

You will be part of a collaborative and performance-driven Aftersales environment, supporting multiple locations and working closely with key functions including Service Operations, Parts, Finance, IT, and CRM.

The team is focused on improving reporting accuracy, enhancing business visibility, and using data and insights to support better decision-making.

**What equips you for the role**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Minimum **5 years of relevant experience** in MIS, Business Intelligence, Analytics, ERP/DMS reporting, or a related data-focused role.
* Previous experience within the **automotive Aftersales environment** is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience developing management reports, dashboards, and analytical models.
* Experience improving reporting efficiency through automation and process standardization.
* Strong ownership, accuracy, collaboration, structured problem-solving, and results orientation.

jobs.title: UAE Branch Accountant | Al-Futtaim Automotive | FAMCO
jobs.description:
**About Al-Futtaim**

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview Of The Role:**

  

* The Branch Accountant supports day-to-day dealership finance operations, ensuring accurate accounting and compliance with financial policies.
* The role involves close collaboration with finance and branch teams to ensure transactions are reviewed, documented, and reconciled. Major responsibilities include supporting vehicle deal documentation, pricing, discount checks, and overseeing cash and banking activities.
* This position requires a focus on the accuracy and timeliness of financial transactions and adherence to month-end timelines.
* The role demands proactive management of daily finance operations within a high-volume automotive environment.

**What You Will Do:**

  

* Review and support the posting of daily branch transactions, including invoices, receipts, customer collections, and vendor payments.
* Support vehicle deals by checking financial aspects, pricing, and discount requests, ensuring accuracy and proper approvals.
* Monitor cash collections, bank deposits, and petty cash, ensuring balances are accurate and reconciled.
* Prepare and follow up on reconciliations for customer accounts, vendor balances, and petty cash.
* Assist with month-end close activities, including accrual inputs, provisions, and journal support.
* Track branch operating expenses, purchase orders, and supplier invoices to identify issues like overspending or miscoding.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies, delegation of authority (DOA), internal controls, and audit requirements.

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

  

* Proficiency in reconciliation and numerical accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Good Excel skills and the ability to manage trackers.
* Ability to manage daily priorities and meet month-end deadlines.

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

  

* Degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related field.
* Basic understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial controls.
* 2-4 years of experience in accounting, branch finance, or high-volume transactional finance.
* Experience with ERP systems, particularly SAP, and dealership finance operations.

**About Al-Futtaim** **Automotive**

  

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

  

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

  

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

  

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

  

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

jobs.title: Accounting-Accountant
jobs.description:
****أهداف الوظيفة****

  

إثبات المصروفات والإيرادات و تسجيل الاصول الثابتة في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية و إعداد التسويات البنكية وإصدار التقارير ذات العلاقة.

  

****اهم المسؤوليات****

  

1.استلام فواتير الموردين وتصنيفها عن طريق إدخالها في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية بغرض إثباتها في الحسابات.

  

2.إعداد سندات الصرف واصدار الشيكات او التحويلات البنكية و متابعة الحصول على التوقيعات اللازمة وفقا للصلاحيات المعتمدة لصرف المبالغ الصحيحة.

  

3.إثبات كافة قيود العمليات المحاسبية حسب التوجيه المحاسبي السليم وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة .

  

4.إعداد التسويات البنكية الدورية وإعداد التسويات اللازمة وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة عن طريق إجراء المقارنات بين فواتير المدفوعات والإيرادات و الدفعات البنكية.

  

5.صرف كشوفات الرواتب الشهرية لموظفي الهيئة عن طريق التحويلات البنكية وفقاً للإجراءات المحاسبية المعتمدة ومتابعة الحصول على الإعتمادات اللازمة للصرف.

  

6.إثبات المنافع المالية ( المنفعة الدورية – منفعة تجهيز مسكن – منفعة السكن المؤقت ) في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية بغرض إثباتها في الحسابات.

  

7.صرف المنافع المالية ( المنفعة الدورية – منفعة تجهيز مسكن – منفعة السكن المؤقت ) من خلال بطاقات المستفيدين للمنفعة .

  

8.إثبات الإيرادات الخاصة بالتراخيص وإعداد الايصالات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية وفقاً للبنود الخاصة بها .

  

9.استلام تقارير التشغيلية لقاعات الأفراح (مثال : قاعات الطوار والبرشاء) من مركز دبي التجاري و مراجعتها وإثبات الإيرادات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية

  

10.التأكد من تحويل ايرادات قاعات الافراح من خلال موقع البنك و إعداد الإيصالات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية.

  

11.التحقق من استلام الشيكات و التحويلات البنكية للمبالغ الواردة من اموال الزكاة و التبرعات و اثباتها في انظمة الموارد الحكومية.

  

12.استلام أوامر صرف أموال الزكاه والمساهمات المجتمعية والتبرعات ولجنة صندوق التضامن و لجنه الحالات الانسانية و ادخالها في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية واثباتها في حسابات الهيئة بهدف توزيعها على الحسابات ذات العلاقة ليتم صرفها للمستحقين وفقاً للاجراءات المعتمدة.

  

13.متابعة ملاحظات الإغلاق الشهري لحسابات الهيئة عن طريق إصدار التقارير المالية من خلال أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية.

  

14.تسجيل الأصول الثابتة في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية لأثباتها في دفاتر حسابات الهيئة.

  

15.المشاركة في فريق الجرد السنوي لإجراء عمليات الجرد السنوية ومطابقتها مع أرصدة الحسابات الموجودة في الأستاذ العام.

  

16.التنسيق مع موظفي المشتريات فيما يتعلق بدفعات الموردين وإعداد مطابقات حسابات الموردين وإعتمادها.

  

17.إعداد التقارير الدورية عن الإيرادات والمصروفات عن طريق أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية وفقاً لمتطلبات الأقسام .

  

18.مراجعة ومطابقة الفواتير مع طلبات الشراء المعتمدة ورفع التوصيات بالمتطلبات مثل ( عقود الشركات ، رسائل تجديد العقود ، العروض المالية للشركات وما إلى ذلك )

  

19.استلام الإيرادات النقدية وإيداعها في حساب البنكي الخاص بإيرادات حكومة دبي.

  

20.الإلتزام بسياسات وإجراءات أمن المعلومات المعتمدة بالهيئة والعمل على الامتثال بالضوابط لضمان سرية المعلومات

  

21.أية مهام أو اختصاصات في نطاق مسؤوليات الوظيفة.

  

****المتطلبات التعليمية****

  

·بكالوريس في المحاسبة أو ما يعادلها.

  

·اجادة اللغتين الانكليزية والعربية(محادثة وكتابة)

  

****متطلبات الخبرة****

  

من 0 – 2 سنوات خبرة في الحسابات.

jobs.title: Audit Associate - ACCA Member
jobs.description:
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Auditor to join our growing audit team in Dubai. In this full-time, on-site role, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive audit and accounting services to both international and domestic clients. You will also advise clients on tax-related matters, offer business advisory services, and support commercial legal needs. The Auditor will work closely with clients to understand their specific requirements, deliver tailored solutions, and maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant regulations and market trends.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

  
* Lead and manage audits for a diverse portfolio of international and domestic clients, ensuring the completion of audits in accordance with IFRS, ISA, and UAE regulations.
  
* Perform in-depth audits of financial statements, internal controls, and risk management processes. Provide valuable advisory services to clients on tax-related matters, business performance, and operational efficiency.
  
* Identify opportunities to improve clients’ internal controls and financial reporting processes.
  
* Develop strong client relationships by understanding their unique needs and delivering tailored audit and advisory solutions.
  
* Prepare and present audit reports, findings, and recommendations to senior management and clients.
  
* Ensure that audits and services are conducted in compliance with local regulations in the UAE, international auditing standards (ISA), and firm policies.
  
* Stay updated on changes in accounting, auditing standards, tax regulations, and industry best practices.
  

  

Required Qualifications:

  
  

  
* Qualified ACCA member.
  
* Minimum of 2 years of recent experience conducting audits for both international and domestic clients in a Dubai-based firm.
  
* In-depth knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), International Standards on Auditing (ISA), and UAE-specific regulatory requirements.
  
* Proven ability to lead audits, manage client relationships, and provide valuable insights into financial performance and risk management.
  
* Strong understanding of financial statement preparation and audit techniques.
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  
* Proficiency in using accounting and audit software (e.g., CaseWare, Excel, other audit tools).
  
* Strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail.
  
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a team.
  
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  

  

Desired Skills:

  
  

  
* Experience working with clients in diverse industries, including multinational corporations, financial institutions, and SMEs.
  
* Leadership experience in managing audit teams and mentoring junior auditors.
  
* Strong business acumen and ability to understand complex business operations.
  
* Ability to manage client expectations and provide high-quality service.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - Aldar Education
jobs.description:
Aldar Education is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst. This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled professional to join the highly successful Aldar family of schools and to help shape the future of Abu Dhabi’s leading school group.

  

Since its inception in 2007 with just 250 students, Aldar Education has grown into a highly sought-after education provider, with more than 25 owned and managed premium and super-premium schools and academies- in partnership with some of the world’s most prestigious institutions including Rugby School, King’s College Wimbledon, and Cranleigh. The Group now serves over 38,000 students through 5,000 educators from more than 100 nationalities to deliver world-class education across a broad range of curricula and learning pathways from nursery through to K12.

  

At Aldar Education, our impact goes far beyond the classroom: we are proud to contribute to the UAE’s vision for a sustainable, knowledge-based economy through premium education. With this in mind, we hire educators and industry professionals who not only embody our values and cultural ethos but also bring a genuine passion for education—qualities central to our mission of shaping the leaders of tomorrow.

  

If you are passionate about excellence and ready to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to apply and be part of our journey.

  

This is an exciting opportunity to join the highly successful Aldar family of schools and to help shape the future of Abu Dhabi’s leading school group.

  
  
Responsibilities:  

**Man Duties:**

  

* **Business Planning:** Contribute to the preparation of monthly, quarterly, annual, and long-term (5–10 years) business plans, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* **Budgeting:** Assist in the end-to-end annual budgeting process, including building Excel-based budget models and preparing management presentation decks.
* **Forecasting:** Support monthly forecasting activities across different entities, and maintain up-to-date cash flow forecasts to ensure liquidity planning and monitoring.
* **Financial Modeling:** Develop and maintain robust financial models to project financial statements over 5–10 years, supporting decision-making and scenario analysis.
* **Capital Planning:** Collaborate with stakeholders on the 5-year Capex planning cycle, focusing on investment evaluation, capital allocation, and profit optimization.
* **Financial Analysis & Reporting:** Provide insightful financial reports and analytical tools to monitor business unit performance, establish benchmarks, and measure goal achievement.
* **Data Management:** Coordinate with departments to collect, validate, and manage data sets, ensuring timely and accurate analysis and reporting.
* **Systems & Tools:** Utilize ERP systems and business intelligence tools to extract, analyze, and present financial and operational data for management reporting.
* **Budget Administration:** Manage the upload, validation, and transfer of budgets across cost centers and business units, ensuring compliance with internal financial policies.
* **Automation:** Identify and implement automation opportunities across FP&A processes using AI, VBA macros, and advanced Excel formulas to streamline reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and financial analysis.

  
Qualifications:  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in business or finance
* Master’s in finance / MBA in finance
* Qualified accountant (CA/ CPA/ ACCA/ CMA)

**Minimum Experience:**

  

* Minimum 3 to 7 years of relevant FP&A work experience

**Job Specific Knowledge & Skills:**

  

* Arabic Speaking Preferred.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage tasks diligently and complete them within deadlines.
* Effective multi-tasking and the ability to perform under pressure.
* Well-organized and capable of managing multiple tasks independently.
* Strong interpersonal skills, particularly in a diverse, multicultural environment.
* Willingness to extend effort beyond typical work hours when necessary.
* Proficiency in operating office equipment (PC, photocopier, etc.).
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and Outlook 365.

**What We Offer:**

  

Aldar Education is a family of world-class, child-centered, and innovative schools based in the UAE. We educate students across our group of owned and managed schools and as we grow, so does our need for highly skilled, inspirational, and dedicated school and educational leaders. We offer an attractive remuneration package including a range of benefits. Our future-focused learning model includes both students and staff, so we place a special emphasis on professional development, coaching, and training.

  

Successful candidates will have access to a wide network of professionals and opportunities to both lead and contribute to training others as well as developing themselves.

  

This job description is not all-inclusive. Aldar Education reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are dedicated to our national development strategy and encourage UAE Nationals in their application to our company.

  

Aldar Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. Offers of appointment are subject to satisfactory references and police clearance

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Full Time Analyst, Dubai, UAE 2027
jobs.description:
Discover your future at Citi  

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

  
  
Job Overview  
  

**You're the brains behind our work**

  
  

You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it's honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can't come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when.

  
  

Citi is looking for full-time Analysts to join the Corporate Banking team in Dubai. Corporate Bankers are relationship-focused finance professionals responsible for understanding the wide range of complex financial issues facing our clients around the world. As a Corporate Banker, you will drive the client dialogue on capital structure, liability management, liquidity and funding strategies, risk management and investment solutions.

  
  

Unique to Citi, Corporate Bankers are also responsible for deciding where to invest the firm's capital and executing on those investments. Corporate Bankers work in partnership with various Citi groups across the firm including Risk Management, Investment Banking and the Capital Markets Origination. If none of these terms make sense right now, that's ok! As a Corporate Banking Analyst, you will join a training program in Dubai, where you will receive an in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi's culture. So whatever your degree is in we will give you the training you need to excel.

  
  

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed**

  
  

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Analyst Program starts in mid-July 2025 and begins with a six to eight week in-depth training program. You will then be placed with a Corporate Banking team to work with for the duration of the Program. By the third year of the program; Analysts will have the opportunity to take advantage of internal mobility opportunities.

  
  

**Your time here will look something like this…**

  

* Conduct accounting and financial statement analysis, cash flow modelling and capital markets analysis.
* Complete fundamental risk and credit analysis.
* Liaise with product partners.
* Assist in the presentation and development of new ideas to clients.
* Structure deals.

  

**We want to hear from you if...**

  

* You are in your final year of university or graduated.
* Strong academics.
* Interest in business.
* You are fluent in English (another European language desirable).

  

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

  
  

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.

  
  

**We'll also be looking for the following:**

  

* Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn and success in team environments.
* Knowledge of the global or domestic business landscape is a plus, but not required
* Strong communication, planning and organizational skills.
* Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry.
* Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making.

  

We will recruit on a rolling basis and therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Successful candidates will be offered a competitive salary.

jobs.title: Branch Accountant | Al-Futtaim Automotive| Dubai
jobs.description:
About Al-Futtaim

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview of the role**

  

We are currently hiring a detail-oriented **Branch Accountant** to support the day-to-day finance operations of a busy automotive branch in the UAE.

  

In this role, you will help ensure that financial transactions are accurate, properly documented, reconciled and processed on time. You will provide operational finance support across sales, aftersales, parts and administration, covering customer collections, vendor payments, banking, petty cash, vehicle deal documentation and month-end closing activities.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Review daily branch transactions, including invoices, receipts, customer collections, vendor payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* Check vehicle deal documentation, pricing requests and discount approvals for accuracy and completeness.
* Monitor cash collections, card receipts, bank deposits, petty cash and other banking activities.
* Prepare reconciliations for customer accounts, vendor balances, deposits, advances, clearing accounts and petty cash.
* Investigate outstanding balances, transaction errors and reconciling items, escalating unresolved issues when required.
* Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, provisions, reclassifications, journals and expense reviews.
* Track operating expenses, purchase orders, supplier invoices and cost-centre postings.
* Identify missing approvals, documentation gaps, unusual financial movements and control exceptions.
* Maintain accurate schedules, trackers and supporting documentation for reporting and audit purposes.
* Ensure branch finance activities comply with applicable financial policies, approval requirements and internal controls.
* Coordinate with branch operations, shared services, treasury, credit control and other finance stakeholders.

**Required skills to be successful**

  

* Good understanding of accounting principles and day-to-day financial transactions.
* Strong reconciliation skills and numerical accuracy.
* Knowledge of receivables, payables, banking, petty cash, accruals and financial controls.
* Good Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to maintain accurate trackers and schedules.
* Working knowledge of SAP or a similar ERP system.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Ability to identify transaction errors, missing approvals and outstanding reconciling items.
* Good communication and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage daily priorities and meet month-end deadlines.
* A reliable, accountable and process-focused approach to work.

**About the team**

  

You will join a collaborative automotive finance team supporting a high-volume branch environment. You will work closely with the Finance Manager, branch management, sales, service and parts teams, as well as shared services, treasury and credit control.

  

The team plays an important role in maintaining strong financial discipline while providing responsive support to daily branch operations.

  

**What equips you for the role**

  

* A degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline.
* **2–4 years of relevant experience** in accounting, branch finance, retail finance, dealership finance or operational finance support.
* Experience preparing reconciliations and supporting month-end closing activities.
* Experience reviewing financial documentation and following up on outstanding items.
* Exposure to automotive, retail, trading or another high-volume transactional environment is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP system is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during month-end and peak transaction periods.

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

  

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

  

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

  

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

  

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.
